correctness.rationale: Since [L_T,L_T]=TV, an ID derivation is uniquely (c,E) with c∈TV and E:V→TV commuting with T; inner ones fill TV⊕KT when T≠0. Thus outer ID quotient is Hom_{K[t]}(V,tV)/KT. Primary decomposition and Hom(K[t]/(f^a), K[t]/(f^b)) dimension deg(f)·min(a,b) give the stated Phi including t-primary exponent shortened by one; all arbitrary fields and char two covered. If T²∉KT, T and T² force at least two independent homs. If T²=λ T with λ≠0, phi=(rank T)²; if λ=0, phi=rank T·(n−rank T); Phi=1 only for rank1 with T²≠0 or rank1,n=2. A fresh independent row-reduction checker exhausted all binary T of sizes 1,2,3 and ternary T of sizes 1,2, confirming the stated boundary; finite checks only corroborate proof.
